meta.name: raffle-winner-picker
meta.description: Picks random winners from lists, spreadsheets, or Google Sheets for giveaways, raffles, and contests. Ensures fair, unbiased selection with transparency.

copy.tagline: 从名单或表格中公平随机抽取中奖者
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从参与者列表中随机、透明地选出获奖者。
copy.tagline_en: Pick random winners fairly from lists or spreadsheets
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to select random winners from participant lists transparently.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以从列表、CSV、Excel 或 Google 表格中随机抽取一个或多个获奖者，并显示抽取过程和时间戳，确保公平透明。
howto.when: 当你需要从名单中随机抽取获奖者、分配名额或分组时，例如社交媒体抽奖、活动抽奖或随机分组。

say.text: 从这份 Google 表格中随机选一个获奖者。
say.note: Claude 会读取表格并随机抽取一行作为获奖者。

say.text: 从 entries.csv 中抽取 3 个不重复的获奖者。
say.note: Claude 会读取文件并随机抽取指定数量的获奖者。

say.text: 从以下列表中随机选一个获奖者：Alice, Bob, Carol。
say.note: Claude 会从你提供的列表中随机选择。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can randomly pick one or more winners from lists, CSV, Excel, or Google Sheets, showing the selection process and timestamp for transparency.
howto.when_en: When you need to randomly select winners from a list, allocate spots, or form teams, e.g., for social media giveaways, event raffles, or random assignments.

say_en.text: Pick a random winner from this Google Sheet.
say_en.note: Claude will read the sheet and randomly select a row as winner.
Claude will read the file and randomly select the specified number of winners.

say_en.text: Pick a random winner from this list: Alice, Bob, Carol.
say_en.note: Claude will randomly choose from the list you provide.
